in_marathi.name: Damodar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Damodar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Damodar is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'one who holds the universe'. In Hindu mythology, Damodar refers to Lord Krishna, who holds the universe on his chest. This name is filled with spiritual significance and symbolizes love, compassion, and the power to hold and protect the universe.
